newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rich says SNB must be expansive if EMU boosts Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Rich says SNB must be expansive if EMU boosts Sfr.

text.p: Swiss National Bank (SNB) chief economist Georg Rich said the central bank would have to follow an expansive monetary policy if the Swiss franc rose again due to turbulance around European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).

Rich told a business seminar that the Swiss franc had eased again recently against major currencies after rising over the past year due to worries on financial markets about EMU plans for a single currency, the Euro.
"If problems like this should occur again, we would have no other choice to follow an expansive monetary policy," Rich said.
But he added that an expansive policy bore a longer term risk of fueling inflation and therefore must be closely watched.
"I expect we will be spared any marked rise of the Swiss franc if the Euro turns out to be a strong currency," he said.
But he said there was no complete certainty that this would be the case.
